title: XPLAT-010 Confinement Guard Allowlist
description: Fail-closed allowlist for the repository Bash confinement guard. Rhymes with the XPLAT-009 historical-allowlist schema but replaces the historical-path predicate with a vendored_specify_helper path scope. Pins exactly the 10 vendored upstream Spec Kit helper .sh files as individual per-file entries (no globs) so the set cannot broaden silently. Any .sh or Bash-shebang file under .specify/** not on this list is a fail-closed blocking finding.

path.description: Repo-relative path to a vendored upstream helper. Must sit under .specify/scripts/bash/** or .specify/extensions/**/scripts/bash/** (the vendored_specify_helper scope).

scope.description: The only path scope the loader accepts; permits only .specify/scripts/bash/** and .specify/extensions/**/scripts/bash/** paths.

release_readiness_excluded.description: Required true on every entry so allowlisted files are excluded from the positive Bash-free evidence set and can never satisfy release readiness (FR-004).
